proof: A fixed pair must cover 14 choices of a third point. Each five-block containing that pair covers three choices, so its count is at least ceil(14/3)=5. For each point, the sum of its 15 incident pair counts equals four times its degree. Hence four times its degree is at least 75, so its degree is at least19.
scope: Exact counts for two existing hints and two checked native finals. These are necessary conditions for full covers, not for partial candidates. Passing them would not prove coverage. No constraint was added to the completed pilot.
